title: Theo Baptiste - Bellhaven Polytechnic
text:
Theo Baptiste directs the applied research group at Bellhaven Polytechnic, where he has taught since 2015 and where the group work is mostly about measurement: what a sensor costs, what it actually reports, and how far you can trust the difference.

Theo studied at Bellhaven Polytechnic himself and returned to it after eleven years in instrumentation.

He lives in Austin and the research group has been remote-first since the building closed for renovation in 2021 and never quite reopened.

His students describe his seminars as slow, which he takes as a compliment, and his office hours as the most useful four hours of the week.
